messages:
alexander: Heads up — proposing a formal 8-week deprecation window for the SDK implicit routing header (it silently changes routing behavior). want to align console metrics + rollout plan before announcing.

maria: +1. which header exactly? `x-redwood-route`?

alexander: yep `x-redwood-route` and the implicit fallback when it's missing. new plan is explicit opt-in via `x-redwood-route-v2` and a feature flag.

ingrid: We Need the dashboard to show both old/effective routing breakdowns during the window. ops and customers will be confused if metrics jump.

sam: agree. telemetry will need to emit `route_policy` and `route_source` (old|explicit|fallback) per request so we can slice costs.

katie: question — quotas: if a tenant relied on implicit routing to land on dedicated capacity, toggling could hit shared buckets. can we surface quota warnings in console?

alexander: good catch. plan: add a per-tenant 'routing-impact' signal that flags requests where `route_source` changes allocation tier. show those in quota dashboard as "potential-impact" alerts.

maria: timeline? I can do SDK deprecation PRs (py/ts/go) but need exact metric names + event payload.

alexander: target: draft spec this week, SDK PRs next week, internal canary for 2 weeks, public announcement after 4 weeks. 8-week full deprecation window.

sam: sample event shape I'll use for telemetry:```json
{ "ts": "<iso>", "client": "py", "version": "1.4.0", "route_policy": "weighted", "route_source": "implicit" }
```

ingrid: console tiles to add: 1) routing source distribution, 2) delta in P50/P95 latency when switching source, 3) estimated monthly cost impact by tenant.

katie: Can we auto-detect likely-breaks by replaying recent traffic with `route_source=explicit` in staging? if error rate rises > 0.5% we warn customers.

alexander: yes — we'll do a dry-run mode. devex, will need a small opt-in flag in SDKs `routing_deprecation_dryrun=true`.

maria: noted. py/ts will default to off. I'll add a small telemetry opt-in checkbox in the quickstart so users can opt into dry-run.

ops-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag-service rollout (canary) -> 2143508000

sam: console schema changes: add `route_source` as enum [implicit, explicit, fallback, dryrun]. keep old metric `routing_tag` for 6 weeks and mark deprecated.

ingrid: also need to preserve historical dashboards: when we flip, ensure we don't rewrite historical aggregates. store `route_source` as new dimension, never backfill to old rows.

alexander: decision recap: - 8-week deprecation window - new header `x-redwood-route-v2` + feature flag - telemetry field `route_source` + `route_policy` - console tiles described by Ingrid - quota "potential-impact" signal - SDK dry-run opt-in for canary

maria: I'll open the py/ts/go PRs today with changelog and migration notes. will include example diff:```diff
- client.call("/generate", headers={})
+ client.call("/generate", headers={"x-redwood-route-v2":"team-123"})
```

katie: We'll want a small migration guide in console: how to check `route_source` slices and enable feature flag per tenant. UX: one-click opt-in for non-prod.

sam: pinging @ingrid for the dashboard mocks by EOD Friday so devex can link them in PRs.

ingrid: on it. mock tiles + sample alerts to you by Friday.

alexander: thanks all. I will post the draft spec + rollout schedule in #eng-platform later today. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: feature-flag-service canary started at 2143508000 (10% nodes)

maria: uploaded py PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-python/pull/412 — includes telemetry opt-in and dryrun flag.

sam: noted. I'll wire the telemetry ingestion to accept `route_source` and expose it in the metrics API.

katie: can we add a short blurb for sales/CS so they can triage tenant questions? I'll draft and post to #customer-success.

alexander: great, let's sync again Monday 11am to review canary metrics.

maria: see you then.
